title: Further law-text captures: ZR 34-22, 34-23, 35-22, 35-641 to 35-643, 23-34 and 23-44 with the sections under them, 23-311, 23-312 and seventeen ZR 12-10 definitions - source text only (D-090 R291)
objective: Capture, as source text only, the law text that the merged captures and readings name as needed and not captured (backlog row DB-170 item (b); the list of pointed-to sections in project-control/reports/M4-T029-producer-report.md, section 8). From the official Zoning Resolution site (zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov), with the capture method and file format of task M4-T029 (each section WHOLE; each request's own time; the print/PDF as a text check; labels from a channel that prints them, or disclosed as positions in the page's markup; a table cell by cell): (1) ZR 34-22 and ZR 34-23 (the exceptions ZR 34-11 names; if either has sections under it, those too); (2) ZR 35-641, 35-642 and 35-643 (the sections under ZR 35-64); (3) ZR 35-22 (named by ZR 35-62); (4) ZR 23-34 and every section under it that is not captured yet (ZR 23-341 among them; ZR 23-342, 23-343 and 23-344 are captured and are NOT captured again), and ZR 23-311 and 23-312 (permitted obstructions in yards, pointed to by ZR 23-343); (5) ZR 23-44 and every section under it (named by ZR 23-43); (6) these ZR 12-10 definitions, each as the WHOLE defined-term article the official page shows, found by searching exact, combined and inverted titles (for example 'yard, rear' as well as 'rear yard'): rear yard; rear yard equivalent; yard; front yard; side yard; lot coverage; curb level; street wall; mixed building; residential equivalent; large site; qualifying residential site; dwelling unit; rooming unit; qualifying affordable housing; qualifying senior housing; and 'prevailing street wall frontage' if ZR 12-10 defines it. For a term ZR 12-10 does not define under any of those title forms, the report says exactly what was searched and what the page shows (the titles nearest to it); nothing is captured from a guess and no term is reported 'not defined' on an exact-title search alone. One file per section and one per defined-term article. A capture holds source text only: no rule, no reading for a lot, no derived number. No existing capture is edited. Anything that cannot be read in full is said so in the capture and the report. No rule file, rule engine, register entry, reference case or screen changes.
business_reason: One independent reading holds the floor area, coverage and rear-yard answers of the overlay case subject to ZR 34-21 to 34-23, of which 34-22 and 34-23 are not captured; the rear yard beyond the corner, the through lot and the permitted obstructions need the yard definitions and ZR 23-34; the legal unit limit for qualifying housing (gap K13) needs the definitions of the qualifying kinds. Step 3 of the owner's eight steps (R291): the text must be captured before any missing rule can be resolved.
